title: Chubby Bird Gym
description: Renovate a cozy pastel fitness studio for adorable chubby chicks by merging workout gear, unlocking treadmills, and keeping every fluffy guest happy.
controls: Tap highlighted orders and merge matching items on the board to earn stars, renovate rooms, and unlock new bird gym equipment.

zh-CN.title: 肥啾瘦身馆
zh-CN.description: 超治愈手绘风「二合 + 模拟经营」爆款：帮圆滚滚的小肥啾翻新温馨健身房，拖拽合成器材、解锁跑步机与花式瘦身设施。
zh-CN.controls: 跟着指引点击图标进入合成棋盘，拖动相同物品二合升级完成订单，用星星装修理想健身房。
